7755.title: Provider updater labels lose executable identity
7755.rootCauseOneLine: The UI splits a shell-formatted command on whitespace and compares only its basename with a potentially absolute executable identity.

prReviews.verdict: Static review: addresses both reproduced mechanisms; PR code not executed.

7755.proposedFix: Decode the formatter's first shell word and normalize both executable basenames; existing linked PR prevents a duplicate fix.
7755.caveats: Linux component fixture reproduction repeated in a second clean checkout by the same agent. No native Windows, live provider update, or screenshot; Chrome and its OS libraries unavailable. Complete regression patch is inline in the HTML report.
